intent:
Bug: the environment OpenAgent sets for a run leaks into the commands the agent runs. In session 2026-11-21T17-50-08-691Z the agent had 4 tests fail because GIT_AUTHOR\_\* and GIT_COMMITTER\_\* overrode the identity the tests give their own commits, and it had to unset 8 variables (OPENAGENT_GIT_ACCOUNT, OPENAGENT_DISTRIBUTION, AGENT_ID, AGENT_DIARY and the four GIT\_ ones) to start a dashboard from its checkout and to open its pull request.

Find which of these the agent's own commands really need and how to give them without breaking a project's tests or a dashboard started inside a run. Add a test that fails without the fix, and open a pull request with a short title and body.
title: Env var leak in agent runs
